resolutions.reason: Removed the distinct Holy See entity from territorial-state variants.
Added Mozambique border as Kruger discriminator.
Mixed landform, city, sea and peninsula answers; broadened category title and removed exhaustive five-country pool.
Retained only Emajõgi from the connected water system and introduced three unrelated identifiable waters.
